_comment: Create a device access in the Remote back office (Devices -> Add device). It gives you the server URL, the one-time token, and the device block. Add scripts/shell below as needed.
_cameras_comment: Local IP cameras to relay. Each needs its OWN device access (Devices -> Add device gives id + token). Find addresses with: python3 agent/remote_agent.py --scan. See the README for each brand's rtsp:// path.
